mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (title, detail, category, priority, due_date, completed, user_id) VALUES (#{todo.title}, #{todo.detail}, #{todo.category}, #{todo.priority}, #{todo.dueDate}, COALESCE(#{todo.completed}, FALSE), #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, detail, category, priority, due_date, completed, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{todo.title}, detail = #{todo.detail}, category = #{todo.category}, priority = #{todo.priority}, due_date = #{todo.dueDate}, completed = #{todo.completed} WHERE id = #{todo.id}
